messages:
maria: massive shoutout to the onboarding pod — jon and tara ran the 'first-week welcome' session and it was SO smooth. new hires are already raving. thank you!! :tada:
jon: thanks! shoutout to diego too for the slide deck cleanup and accessible alt text :clap:
tara: and extra thanks to yuki for coordinating the buddy pairings, you made matchups feel thoughtful not random :sparkles:
diego: happy to help. also brought donuts and labeled vegan options so nobody gets surprised :doughnut:
yuki: pairing notes saved to the docs repo: https://redwood.docs/onboarding/pairings (tiny tweak: added timezone preferences)
product-bot: automated note: new-hire survey sent to cohort (3 responses so far)
maria: two small asks: 1) whoever does snacks next week, please leave a note about allergens; 2) if you volunteered to be a buddy, ping the person by EOD so they don't sit in limbo
jon: will ping my buddy after standup
tara: added a quick checklist to the onboarding doc about snack/allergen etiquette and desk plants (lol)
diego: random extra kudos to facilities for fixing the heating in the breakroom this morning  made the snack hour cozy :fire:
yuki: emojis for appreciation: react with :heart: for onboarding team, :raised_hands: for facilities, :cookie: for snack heroes
ops-bot: reaction summary  :heart: 7, :raised_hands: 4, :cookie: 3
maria: you all are stars. micro-moments like this make joining feel human. :sun_with_face:
